tip.title: obwohl vs. trotzdem
tip.body: Obwohl (although) starts a subordinate clause, so its verb goes to the end: Obwohl ich müde bin, schaue ich noch eine Folge. Trotzdem (still, nevertheless) takes position one and the verb follows straight after: Ich habe wenig Zeit. Trotzdem höre ich Podcasts. Pronunciation: stress the first syllable, OBwohl.

lessons.title: Pros and cons of technology
lessons.goal: Discuss advantages and disadvantages of technology and explain why you use it.

tip.title: um ... zu and damit
tip.body: To express a purpose with the same subject, use um ... zu + infinitive: Ich nutze mein Handy, um Deutsch zu lernen. With a different subject, use damit and put the verb at the end: Ich schicke dir den Link, damit du den Artikel lesen kannst. Fluency tip: "Der Vorteil ist, dass" and "Der Nachteil ist, dass" are great frames for longer answers.

tip.title: seit + present tense
tip.body: For something that started in the past and is still going on, German uses seit with the present tense: Das WLAN ist seit gestern langsam. English would say "has been". Seit takes the dative: seit einer Woche, seit drei Tagen.

lessons.title: Infinitive with zu
lessons.goal: Use zu + infinitive after verbs like vergessen and versuchen.

tip.title: zu + infinitive goes to the end
tip.body: After verbs and phrases like vergessen, versuchen, keine Lust haben or es ist wichtig, the second verb goes to the end with zu: Ich habe vergessen, das Handy aufzuladen. With separable verbs, zu slips into the middle: aufzuladen, anzurufen. For a purpose, use um ... zu: um Filme zu schauen.

lessons.title: My media life
lessons.goal: Talk for about 45 seconds about how and why you use media.

culture.title: The Rundfunkbeitrag
culture.body: In Germany every household pays the Rundfunkbeitrag (about 18 euros a month) for public TV and radio like ARD, ZDF and Deutschlandfunk — even if you never watch TV. Austria has a similar ORF-Beitrag and Switzerland the Serafe fee. Many Germans still watch the Tagesschau news at 8 p.m. as an evening ritual.

phrases.n: I pay the licence fee although I hardly watch TV.
